description: This file defines an abstract class 'NonCryptographicHashAlgorithm' used as a base for implementing non-cryptographic hash algorithms within the Orleans code generation framework. It contains methods for processing data streams, obtaining hash values, and resetting state, serving as a fundamental component for hashing purposes in the project.

classes.name: NonCryptographicHashAlgorithm
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a non-cryptographic hash algorithm with methods to append data, compute hashes, reset state, and handle asynchronous operations.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the hash. Overloaded to accept byte arrays and streams, including asynchronous support.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash state to initial.

methods.name: GetCurrentHash
methods.description: Returns the current hash value without modifying state.

methods.name: TryGetCurrentHash
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current hash value, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: GetCurrentHash
methods.description: Writes the current hash to a provided span.

methods.name: GetHashAndReset
methods.description: Returns the current hash and resets the state.

methods.name: TryGetHashAndReset
methods.description: Attempts to get the hash and reset, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: GetHashAndReset
methods.description: Writes the hash to a span and then resets the hash state.
